## Summary and bounded contribution

Describe the implemented problem, source/evidence version and what is not claimed.

## Included files and risks

List engine/dashboard/data/model/documentation/paper changes separately, dependencies and artifact storage choices. Preserve raw evidence and inherited work.

## Verification

Provide exact commands, exit codes, distinct case counts, skips/deselections, raw output locations and failed attempts/corrections. Separate retained results from new demonstrations and integrity checks from scientific validation.

## Scientific limitations

- Synthetic environment; no real-world UPI effectiveness claim.
- Historical detector ancestry limitations and narrow registered holdout.
- Benign distribution-shift failure; offline policy-cost asymmetry.
- Exploratory replication; no powered confirmatory lockbox.
- Gate C HOLD.

## Reviewer guide

Link README, setup, dashboard, short demo, raw evidence, tables/figures, paper, literature matrix, limitations and verification.

## Safety and acceptance

- [ ] Complete diff and secret/artifact inventory reviewed.
- [ ] No raw result edits or weakened tests.
- [ ] No caches, environments, personal data or credentials.
- [ ] Current base ancestry verified.
- [ ] External AI/similarity reports genuine or explicitly pending.
- [ ] No default push, PR merge or Gate C action.
